== Course of events ==

After Alice drinks from an unlabeled bottle discovered in the White Rabbit's room, she grows to an extraordinary size, becoming trapped within the house with her limbs protruding grotesquely from the window and chimney. The White Rabbit and the other animals, gathering outside, devise a scheme to retrieve her from this predicament. Recognizing the peculiar crisis before them, they determine to send a creature named Bill down through the chimney to dislodge the girl from her impossible position.

When Bill descends into the chimney, Alice, resorting to the resourcefulness that has become her constant companion in this bewildering place, delivers a violent kick that sends him flying outward and away from the house. The attempt at extraction fails in the most dramatic fashion, and Bill's expulsion marks the turning point of the rescue effort. Alice's forceful response, born of her determination to escape her confinement, demonstrates the courage she has come to possess in the face of Wonderland's absurdities.
